name: Modern Keystrokes
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: marblock
description: A fabric mod that display keystrokes and CPS (26.3-1.20.1)

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Keystrokes (W A S D, space, mouse buttons), FPS and ms boxes on the HUD. FPS and ms boxes, W A S D, a space bar and two mouse boxes at the top left; the W box lights white while W is held; all gone with F1.
